boundaries: Offline independent parsing only: no runner.verify, imports of test runners, Cargo build or QEMU execution.
Four regression runtimes were terminal in sequence.json before review. This report does not validate the separate new journal scenario or the two local-only runs.

Original normal/hot/ECM/TERM guest/probe scripts are unchanged from a484d11. Normal wait0/stopped evidence exercises close-and-Finish in frozen product source; these older regression harnesses do not independently archive per-grant journal records, so record retirement in these four runs is inferred through that guarded success path, not direct disk evidence.

Physical normal/hot and TERM do not archive raw host FTDI sink payload files. Exact byte observations rely on preserved collector digests plus frozen guest cmp/assertions; this report does not invent absent raw bytes. TERM evdev and ECM private Ethernet PCAP bytes were independently decoded.

All four runs are all-features Linux x86_64/QEMU simulated USB devices using the recorded 6.8.0-106-generic guest kernel. No host USB, real hardware G1/G2, Windows support, automatic SIGKILL recovery, arbitrary FD revocation or power-loss durability is established.

Existing configuration-barrier probe receipts are retained; they do not establish the separate Linux-internal blocked-syscall window, successful clear-halt on arbitrary hardware or general ISO support.
